papers.title_en: MetaAct: Self-Evolving Executable Action Constraints for Embodied Language Agents
papers.authors: Jiaxing Zhao, Hanwen Wang, Di Liu, Shaoteng Liu, Jing-Ran Su, Yanheng Li, Qian Zha, Jiaxi Li, Hongbin Xie, Haoran Zhang, Xuan Song, Haoxuan Che
papers.evidence: 通过环境执行反馈改进具身智能体的行动约束
papers.tldr: 具身语言智能体需要在包含离散、常不可逆操作的环境中避免非法动作，但现有自进化方法主要修改文本，只能影响偏好，难以保证动作可执行。MetaAct依据执行反馈合成具身可执行动作规则（GEAR），将其编译为确定性守卫，并通过离线轨迹回放验证，无需额外调用模型或交互环境。在四个基准上，MetaAct均提升任务表现；ScienceWorld违规率从70%降至0%，WebShop从40%降至1%，得分分别提高10.1和8.0。该方法把经验转化为可执行约束，增强了智能体行为的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Self-evolving language agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for continuously improving agent behavior through experience. However, most existing approaches evolve textual artifacts, which can influence action preferences but cannot reliably enforce action admissibility in embodied environments with discrete and often irreversible actions. We propose MetaAct, which shifts self-evolution from textual guidance to executable action constraints by synthesizing GEAR (Grounded Executable Action Rules) from execution feedback. Each rule is represented as a typed specification, compiled into a deterministic guard, and validated offline through trajectory replay without additional model calls or environment interactions. Across four benchmarks, MetaAct improves task performance; on ScienceWorld and WebShop, violations drop from 70% to 0% and 40% to 1%, with score gains of +10.1 and +8.0. Our code is available at https://github.com/BaiCubed/MetaAct.

papers.title_en: Efficient Multi-View Generation with Iterative Global-Local Proxy Attention
papers.authors: Wei Tan, Kunming Luo, Hongyu Yan, Yu Zhang, Zihao Zhang, Xiatian Zhu, Lei Xie
papers.evidence: 从单张图像生成多视角图像与法线图以服务三维重建
papers.tldr: 从单张图像生成一致的多视角RGB图像与法线图，可为三维重建提供外观和几何线索，但视角间密集注意力会随视角数及分辨率增长而开销过高。论文提出全局-局部代理注意力，在每个视角内保留全分辨率交互，并以紧凑代理完成跨视角通信；同一步去噪中还迭代更新代理并复用注意力参数。实验覆盖FLUX与Stable Diffusion：注意力计算分别加速2.65倍和1.80倍，且质量指标整体改善。结果表明该方法兼顾效率与一致性，可降低多视角生成和重建的计算成本。
papers.abstract_en: Generating consistent multi-view RGB images and normal maps from a single input image provides complementary appearance and geometric cues for 3D reconstruction. However, maintaining cross-view consistency requires information exchange across viewpoints, and dense cross-view attention becomes computationally expensive as the number of views and spatial resolution increase. In this paper, we propose Global-Local Proxy Attention (GLPA) to reduce cross-view communication costs while preserving fine-grained within-view processing. Specifically, GLPA retains full-resolution interactions within each view and uses compact global proxies for cross-view communication. To further leverage the exchanged information, GLPA incorporates iterative proxy refinement, which rebuilds the proxies from updated features and reuses the same attention parameters for subsequent interactions within a single denoising step. We evaluate GLPA on two structurally different diffusion backbones, FLUX and Stable Diffusion. Experiments on FLUX show that GLPA achieves a $2.65\times$ speedup in attention computation per denoising step over dense attention, while improving reconstruction IoU from 0.6849 to 0.7019 and reducing NVS LPIPS from 0.086 to 0.076. Results on Stable Diffusion further demonstrate the effectiveness of GLPA, with a $1.80\times$ attention speedup and improvements across all five quality metrics.

papers.title_en: UNITE: Consolidating Embodied VLM Specialists via Shared-Anchor One-Bit Factorization
papers.authors: Tao Tao, Anke Tang, Enneng Yang, Zhi Hou, Xiaogang Wang, Dacheng Tao
papers.evidence: 整合视觉定位、空间推理、导航和驾驶等具身能力专家
papers.tldr: 具身视觉语言模型常将视觉定位、空间推理、导航和驾驶理解分散在多个专用模型中，分别部署耗存储，直接合并又可能损伤专长。UNITE 将专家前馈网络保留为可路由模块，并用共享浮点锚点与逐行缩放的二值偏差压缩专家权重。四个 Qwen3-VL-8B 专家组成的模型仅占 20.3 GB，较未压缩混合专家模型减少 59.6%，在 22 项基准及导航测试中保持强表现。该方法以接近单模型的存储整合互补能力，并在多项三维场景理解与导航任务上超过源专家。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied capabilities such as visual grounding, spatial reasoning, navigation, and driving understanding are often developed in separate vision-language specialists fine-tuned from a common pretrained model.Deploying the specialists separately multiplies storage, whereas merging them into one dense model forces conflicting task updates to share parameters and loses part of each specialist's expertise.We introduce UNITE, a framework that consolidates such specialists into a compact shared-backbone mixture of experts. UNITE keeps the feed-forward block of each specialist as a routable expert and represents the expert bank through a shared-anchor one-bit factorization: a shared floating-point anchor plus expert-specific, row-scaled binary deviations.The anchor is optimized jointly with the scales and signs through closed-form alternating updates, using only source weights and no calibration data.Router adaptation then adjusts token-level expert selection with the backbone and experts frozen, updating fewer than $0.6$M parameters ($<0.01\%$ of the $8.8$B active parameters). Built from four Qwen3-VL-8B specialists, the complete UNITE model occupies $20.3$ GB, $1.16\times$ the storage of one dense specialist and $59.6\%$ below the uncompressed MoE. Across $22$ benchmarks and R2R Val-Unseen, UNITE matches six static merging methods in mean retention of best-specialist performance, leads all of them on Scan2Cap, ScanQA, and all four navigation metrics, and surpasses every source specialist on all five 3D scene understanding benchmarks (up to $+19.1$ on Scan2Cap) and on R2R navigation. Relative to the uncompressed MoE, factorization is nearly lossless on $21$ of $22$ benchmarks; the exception is VSI-Bench, where frame-count experiments suggest impaired use of cross-frame evidence.UNITE thus consolidates complementary embodied capabilities near single-model storage.

papers.title_en: IGRecon4D: Dynamic-Object-Aware Feed-Forward Reconstruction of Driving Scenes
papers.authors: Yifei Tong, Ziyang Huang, Yizhao Han, Xiaoxiao Long, Hao Zhu
papers.evidence: 前馈动态驾驶场景三维重建及几何漂移改进
papers.tldr: 前馈式四维驾驶场景重建虽能高效建模动态环境，却常把交通参与者泄漏到静态表示中，并出现高斯位置跨视角漂移。IGRecon4D训练时利用实例级语义先验，通过实例—动态一致性约束学习高召回动态区域掩码；同时以稀疏激光雷达引导深度估计，将深度反投影结果用于锚定高斯位置。在Waymo开放数据集上，该方法改善全图重建；在nuScenes零样本评测中，交通参与者区域表现更强。结果表明，实例先验与激光雷达几何约束可互补地提升动态驾驶场景重建及跨数据集适应能力。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward 4D driving-scene reconstruction enables efficient modeling of dynamic autonomous-driving scenes, but current methods suffer from two complementary failure modes: semantic leakage of traffic participants into the static representation and geometric drift of Gaussian locations across viewpoints. We propose \textbf{IGRecon4D}, a feed-forward dynamic scene reconstruction framework that addresses these failures with training-time instance-prior distillation and LiDAR-anchored Gaussian positioning. Specifically, an instance-level semantic branch provides a potentially dynamic participant prior, which is distilled into dynamic-mask learning through the Instance-Dynamic Consistency Constraint to encourage high-recall localization of traffic-participant regions prone to dynamic-static leakage. In parallel, sparse LiDAR measurements guide dense depth estimation, and the resulting depths are back-projected to anchor Gaussian positions for improved multi-view geometric consistency. Experiments on the Waymo Open Dataset and zero-shot evaluation on nuScenes demonstrate improved full-image reconstruction on the main benchmark and stronger traffic-participant-region reconstruction under cross-dataset evaluation.

papers.title_en: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
papers.authors: Jeonghwan Cho, Minsu Kim, Junyoung Hong, Seon Joo Kim
papers.evidence: 以深度分组监督三维高斯对象，改善场景分割的体积完整性。
papers.tldr: 三维高斯泼溅支持对高斯基元进行对象级操作，但现有分割主要依赖渲染视图训练与评估，可能得到外观准确、体积却不完整的掩码。原因是透明度混合让监督梯度集中于主要贡献者，遮挡或低贡献高斯容易漏选。VODA依据局部深度结构将像素贡献者分组，并直接监督所选深度簇内全部高斯；论文还提出对象移除基准Removal-3D及深度变化指标RDE。实验显示，VODA提升四种基线的体积分割，并在LERF、ScanNet上保持或改善表现，为衡量与改善三维分割完整性提供了方法和基准。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D while maintaining or improving performance on LERF and ScanNet. Further analysis shows that VODA recovers lower-contribution Gaussians, while simple gradient reweighting and spatial propagation fail to reproduce comparable gains.

papers.title_en: FrameSeg3D: Learned Local Frames for Segmenting Small Parts on High-Resolution 3D Scans
papers.authors: Xinwen Zhang, Tongyan Wang, Huawei Lin
papers.evidence: 对高分辨率三维扫描中的细小部件进行分割
papers.tldr: 指甲、牙齿等小部件只占高分辨率三维扫描的一小部分，边界变化细微且朝向各异；整图方法受限于内存或投影分辨率，局部方法则常依赖特定类别先验。FrameSeg3D先从低分辨率整图预测各部件的中心和朝向，再围绕局部坐标系按扫描原始分辨率提取视图进行分割，使部件居中、正对相机且尺度固定。实验中，指甲平均Dice达0.970，牙齿每牙IoU达96.5、边界IoU达70.5。该方法兼顾精细边界与跨部件适用性，并能以较少标注学习。
papers.abstract_en: Segmenting small parts on high-resolution 3D scans, such as nails on hand scans and teeth on intraoral scans, poses three challenges: 1) each part covers a tiny fraction of the scan, 2) its boundary is only a subtle change of height and curvature, and 3) it faces its own direction. Existing methods fall into two groups, and both fall short. The first group processes the whole scan at once and sees each part too coarsely. Point and mesh networks must shrink the scan to fit in memory, so a small part keeps only a few of its points. Multi-view methods render images of the whole object, so each part fills only a few pixels and a tilted part is seen from the side. The second group first finds each part and then segments it up close. But these methods find the parts with knowledge about one kind of part, for example the shape of the dental arch for teeth. Such knowledge does not carry over to other kinds of parts. We find that accuracy is limited by how a part is seen, from which direction and at what scale, not by how many points land on it. We therefore present FrameSeg3D. It first predicts a local frame for every part, its center and the direction it faces, from a low-resolution view of the whole scan. It then segments the part in views around its frame normal at the scanner's resolution, so covering the whole scan no longer costs resolution. Because every part arrives centered, facing the camera, and at a fixed scale, one segmentation network can serve different kinds of parts and learn from few labeled masks. We test FrameSeg3D on two kinds of parts, nails and teeth. It outperforms state-of-the-art methods on hand scans (mean Dice 0.970 on nails) and on the Teeth3DS+ test fold (per-tooth IoU 96.5), with the most accurate tooth boundaries (boundary IoU 70.5).

papers.title_en: Any2Building: Unifying Point Clouds and Images for Building Reconstruction via Shared Spatial Queries
papers.authors: Hongye Hou, Zhuoxiao Li, Liu Xiangyu, Tengxi Wang, Jing Ou, Dongli Wu, Shuai Zhang, Tongyan Hua, Wufan Zhao
papers.evidence: 从部分点云和图像重建结构化三维建筑
papers.tldr: 城市三维建模与数字孪生需要从有限观测中恢复完整、结构化的建筑，但局部点云和俯视图像各自信息不全，且线索类型不同。Any2Building将点云、图像及可选粗略几何先验组织为占据约束的共享三维空间查询，以完整建筑表面体素监督结构预测，并通过表面生成和低多边形重网格得到LoD2模型。在多项基准中，该方法提升点云补全、单图建筑生成和先验辅助生成的几何精度，对点云退化也保持较稳健的恢复能力。研究还发布覆盖18座城市、约百万组配对样本的数据集，推动多模态建筑重建的统一建模与评测。
papers.abstract_en: Abstracting structured buildings from limited observations is essential for 3D urban modeling and digital twins. Partial point clouds and overhead images of the same building provide incomplete 3D surface measurements and visual cues to its footprint, roof geometry, and rooftop structures, respectively. This motivates a unified framework that aligns geometric and visual cues in 3D and reconstructs buildings from either or both modalities. Building on this connection, we present Any2Building, a unified model for Level of Detail 2 (LoD2) building reconstruction from partial point clouds, overhead images, or both, with optional coarse geometric priors. At its core is an occupancy-grounded shared spatial queries representation that organizes available observations within a common 3D grid. Supervised by complete building surface voxels, these queries connect observational evidence to target geometry, enabling a shared generator to learn structural priors across tasks and providing spatial guidance for recovering missing structure. A trained voxel conditional surface-generation and low-poly remeshing pipeline then converts the predicted structure into compact LoD2 building models. To support this framework, we introduce BuildingWorld-Image, comprising approximately one million paired samples of partial point clouds, overhead images, and LoD2 building models across 18 cities. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that Any2Building outperforms existing methods in geometric reconstruction accuracy across unimodal and multimodal point-cloud completion, single-image building generation, and prior-assisted generation, while maintaining detailed and robust recovery when point cloud input modality is degraded.

papers.title_en: NIRJALA: Draining the Sea out of Gaussian Splatting with Three-Path Optics and Reversible Physics
papers.authors: Latchan Chhetri, Aman Kumar
papers.evidence: 通过高斯溅射与三路径成像模型联合恢复水下几何和无水外观
papers.tldr: 水下成像中的直达光衰减、后向散射与前向散射相互混合，使场景外观和水体难以分离；仅校正前两种效应的高斯泼溅方法还会因指数透射反演而产生无界增益。NIRJALA以TRIVENI建模三条光路，利用PRATIBIMBA双向约束神经水体与物理参数，并通过SAMARASA联合优化外观和几何。作者构建含30个受控场景的SAJALA基准，方法提升图像质量与深度估计；在真实场景中也改善感知指标，渲染速度达44帧每秒。该工作提供有界反演和可评测的水下高斯重建方案。
papers.abstract_en: Water does not just tint an underwater photograph; it rewrites it. Each pixel mixes attenuated scene radiance, backscattered light, and scene light scattered forward on its way to the camera, and many combinations of scene and water explain the same pixels. Most Gaussian-splatting methods for underwater scenes model only the first two effects and remove the water by dividing by a transmission that decays exponentially with range, so their inversion gain grows without bound. We present NIRJALA (Sanskrit for "without water"), a 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that recovers water-free appearance and geometry together. TRIVENI, a three-path image formation model, adds a range-saturating forward-scattering term to direct transmission and backscatter; we prove that this keeps the inversion gain bounded at every range and bound how errors in the estimated backscatter and attenuation propagate into the recovered colours. PRATIBIMBA, a reversible physics anchor, ties a flexible neural water model to a ten-parameter physical model in both directions, so scene content cannot hide inside the water. SAMARASA collects the physics-informed objectives, including a range-binned colour prior. To score water removal against ground truth, we built SAJALA ("with water"), a 30-scene suite path-traced in Blender Cycles with water-free images, depth, and normals under controlled water colour and turbidity. On SAJALA, NIRJALA raises PSNR from 24.34 to 24.76 dB and lowers depth AbsRel from 0.109 to 0.091 against the strongest baseline; on real SeaThru-NeRF scenes it lowers LPIPS from 0.194 to 0.175 while rendering at 44 FPS. We also discuss where appearance metrics and geometry disagree underwater, and the limits of our evaluation.

papers.title_en: Stereo Visual Odometry with In-the-Loop Geometric Feed-Forward Models Towards Dense Metric Mapping
papers.authors: Fahira Afzal Maken, Sagun Man Singh Shrestha, Edward Vanderfeen, Lucas Carvalho de Lima, Rongxin Li, Changming Sun, Milad Ramezani
papers.evidence: 结合视觉里程计与几何前馈模型进行稠密深度估计和度量制图
papers.tldr: 立体视觉里程计可提供可靠的稀疏度量几何，但单靠稀疏信息难以形成稠密地图，学习式深度预测又可能不准确。本文将几何前馈模型接入基于因子图的视觉里程计，以优化后的三维路标联合估计各局部子图内深度预测的尺度与偏移。局部滑窗优化位姿和路标，子图内外分别通过几何配准与相似变换对齐，并纳入全局因子图。实验表明，该方法保持有竞争力的定位精度，同时实现准确稠密度量重建，并提升对深度预测失效的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: We present a stereo visual odometry (SVO) framework that integrates geometric feed-forward models (GFMs) for dense depth prediction with factor-graph-based visual odometry to achieve accurate localisation and dense metric mapping. Our key idea is to exploit sparse but reliable metric geometry estimated from stereo and temporal multi-view observations to calibrate dense GFM predictions, while retaining the robustness and efficiency of model-based SVO. Rather than directly conditioning the GFM on potentially noisy stereo depth, optimised 3D landmarks are used to jointly estimate a scale-shift transformation over all keyframes within each local submap, yielding metrically consistent dense depth predictions. To balance accuracy and computational efficiency, we introduce a hierarchical factor-graph architecture. At the local level, sliding-window optimisation estimates high-frequency camera poses and multi-view-refined 3D landmarks. Dense predictions are generated only for selected keyframes and registered within each submap using SE(3) Generalised ICP. Consecutive submaps are further aligned in Sim(3) using their shared geometry, allowing residual scale inconsistencies to be corrected. These intra- and inter-submap constraints are incorporated into a global factor graph to produce a consistent trajectory and dense metric reconstruction. Extensive experiments on public and in-house datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves competitive odometry accuracy against geometric and learning-based baselines while providing accurate dense metric reconstruction and improved robustness to failures in learned depth prediction.

papers.title_en: DfD-GS: Defocus Image Prior for Metric-Scale Single-View Depth Estimation and View Synthesis
papers.authors: Shiori Ueda, Rinto Yagawa, Hideo Saito, Shohei Mori
papers.evidence: 单视图度量深度估计与三维场景重建
papers.tldr: 从单一视点恢复度量尺度几何本质上存在歧义，单目深度先验虽能估计结构，却可能受尺度不确定和数据偏差影响，降低新视角合成的可靠性。DfD-GS利用全焦与离焦图像对及离焦强度估计度量视差，并以此校准单目深度先验，再预测可见和被遮挡的三维高斯。实验显示，该方法在Booster和Middlebury合成离焦数据上优于单图基线；在WildRGB-D上AbsRel和LPIPS更低，但深度RMSE较高。分析还发现其度量尺度对视场变化更稳定，说明物理离焦线索有助于单视图尺度恢复与场景合成。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering metric-scale geometry from observations at a single viewpoint remains fundamentally ill-posed, limiting the reliability of novel view synthesis. Recent methods rely on learned monocular depth priors, which provide strong structural estimates but can suffer from scale ambiguity and dataset-dependent biases. We propose DfD-GS, a feed-forward framework that predicts a metric-scale 3D Gaussian scene representation from a single-view all-in-focus--defocused image pair. The key idea is to exploit defocus blur as a physical metric depth cue. DfD-GS first estimates a defocus-based metric disparity map from the all-in-focus--defocused image pair and the corresponding defocus strength. This estimate is used to align and refine a monocular depth prior to metric scale. Visible and hidden 3D Gaussians are then predicted for occlusion-aware novel view synthesis. Experiments on synthetic-defocus datasets constructed from Booster and Middlebury show that DfD-GS outperforms single-image baselines in metric depth estimation and novel view synthesis. On WildRGB-D, DfD-GS achieves lower AbsRel and LPIPS but higher depth RMSE than the single-image baselines. Additional analyses show that DfD-GS maintains a more stable metric scale under field-of-view changes. Qualitative results on a real dataset show recovery of the main scene structure under optical defocus.

papers.title_en: TRR: A Thermal Interaction Engine for Robot Simulation and RGBT Data Generation
papers.authors: Biwen Yang, Zhe Cao, Jin Zhang, Haoyang Sun, Zonglu Hu, Jintao Zhao, Zhehao Zhang, Kaizheng Chen, Chengyi Liu, Chengyu Wei, Siyuan Wu, Ruiheng Zhang
papers.evidence: 模拟机器人接触交互并生成同步视觉与热成像数据，契合具身智能研究。
papers.tldr: 机器人释放物体后残留的热量、随物体迁移的热量及表层下储热，会影响后续接触，仅凭当前温度难以描述这种跨动作因果关系。TRR为接触双方维护空间与深度分辨热状态，模拟接触、搬运和分离中的热交换，并同步生成RGB热成像观测、状态、动作与任务检查。研究构建六项任务、2224组成对静态与动态轨迹；利用热历史，安全接触点选择率由75.0%升至91.7%，新加热流程下迁移任务完成率提高50个百分点。该引擎与数据流程为热交互机器人仿真及训练提供可复用基础。
papers.abstract_en: A robot's actions change the thermal conditions of its next interaction: heat retained after release, carried with objects or stored beneath the surface can change a later contact's outcome despite similar current temperatures. Training trajectories must capture how these effects connect earlier actions to later observations and task outcomes. We present TRR, a \emph{Thermal Robot Renderer} that attaches spatial and depth-resolved thermal state to both contact partners, updates local heat exchange through contact, transport and separation, and generates synchronized RGB--thermal (RGBT) observations and event-local task checks on one execution clock. Controlled interventions show why retained heat, spatial transport and internal storage matter for subsequent contact outcomes. From the same state, TRR produces a paired six-task benchmark of 2,224 static--dynamic pairs, that is, 4,448 trajectories with synchronized dual-view observations, states and actions. Visible thermal history raises safe contact-site selection from 75.0\% to 91.7\% on a dedicated learning corpus, and training on dynamic histories raises simulated transfer completion by 50 percentage points under a new heating procedure with shared feedback execution. We demonstrate RGBT observation adapters on MuJoCo and Isaac Sim, report an engineering inventory of ten prepared robot configurations and six demonstrated camera viewpoints, and describe a developer workflow that carries an existing robot scene to exported RGBT records. The benchmark, the workflow and the platform resources described in Section 6 form the first items of a planned public release. Demonstrations and resource updates are available on the project page.

papers.title_en: Driving the Style: Velocity-Conditioned Whole-Body Control from Motion Demonstrations
papers.authors: Murad Dawood, Oezge Drama Berkenkamp, Antonio Gonzales Marin, Nutan Chen
papers.evidence: 训练人形机器人以身体动作在现实环境中移动
papers.tldr: 人形机器人模仿动作示范已有进展，但依赖未来参考轨迹的全身跟踪难以适应训练集外动作，对抗式模仿也不易迁移到硬件。本文仅用紧凑速度指令与机器人观测驱动策略，将参考动作用于全身跟踪奖励和特权评论家，而不向执行策略输入关节轨迹，也无需教师蒸馏。仅凭单一随机行走示范训练，策略在留出速度指令下仿真成功率至少达98%，并完成全部Unitree G1实机试验。该方法在慢走测试中远胜对照，体现了以奖励编码示范风格、实现更可靠风格迁移的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Achieving human-like behavior on humanoid robots has advanced rapidly by leveraging motion-capture demonstrations rather than hand-crafted cost functions. Adversarial imitation supplies a style signal that lets a policy fulfill a task while adhering to a desired style, but is difficult to transfer to hardware. Whole-body tracking through reinforcement learning instead deploys reliably and imitates demonstrations faithfully, but the resulting policies are conditioned on the future reference, so they require a reference trajectory at runtime and can fail when the motion differs from the training data. We train a humanoid policy directly with whole-body tracking rewards while restricting its actor to compact locomotion commands and robot observations. Reference motion supervises the reward and privileged critic, without supplying reference joint trajectories to the actor or requiring teacher distillation. The demonstrated style is thereby encoded in the policy through the tracking reward, so the robot reproduces the whole-body style under commanded velocities. Trained on a single random-walk motion and commanded with velocity profiles from held-out motions, our policy reaches at least 98\% success in simulation and completes every trial on the Unitree G1. On held-out slow walking, whole-body tracking drops to 2\% success and command-conditioned distillation to 56\%, and both fail on the real robot. On the trained motions, the joint position error of our policy stays within 8\% of whole-body tracking, and it has a higher style coverage than adversarial motion priors (AMP), which fell on the real robot without a safety crane.

papers.title_en: FAVR: Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.authors: Qixuan Wu, Xiaole Yang, Yuguang Yang, Canyu Chen, Linlin Yang, Haixia Pan, Guodong Guo, Baochang Zhang
papers.evidence: 将时序视觉特征注入视觉语言动作策略以支持机器人操作
papers.tldr: 预训练视频表征能提供丰富的时序信息，但如何有效融入已有视觉语言动作策略，仍是机器人操作中的难题。FAVR为冻结策略加入轻量视觉条件：用线性测试时训练维护紧凑时序状态，并在流式动作生成各阶段检索条件视觉特征。方法利用冻结动作头的仿射结构优化视觉通道门控，采用快速迭代阈值算法求解，并给出高效闭式近似。仅需174万至219万可训练参数和5000步适配，RoboTwin清洁及随机条件下均有提升；五任务消融中，逐阶段门控使成功率从72%升至82%。这表明按动作生成进程调整视觉条件，可低成本增强预训练策略。
papers.abstract_en: Pretrained video representations provide rich temporal information for robotic manipulation, yet effectively integrating them into existing vision-language-action (VLA) policies remains challenging. We present Flow-Aware Visual Residual Alignment (FAVR), a lightweight framework for flow-aware visual conditioning of frozen VLA policies. FAVR maintains a compact temporal visual state through linear Test-Time Training (TTT) and retrieves action-conditioned visual features throughout flow-based action generation. By exploiting the affine structure of the frozen action head, we explicitly characterize how injected visual features influence predicted action velocities and formulate flow-aware channel selection as a box-constrained optimization problem. We develop a FISTA-based solver for joint gate optimization and derive an efficient closed-form approximation through diagonalization and rescaling. With only 1.74-2.19M trainable parameters and 5,000 adaptation steps, FAVR improves pretrained VLA policies across benchmarks. On RoboTwin 2.0, FAVR improves LingBot-VLA from 87.12% to 90.04% under clean conditions and from 86.88% to 89.38% under randomized conditions. A controlled ablation on five RoboTwin tasks further shows that flow-aware gating increases average success from 72.0% with a gate shared across flow steps to 82.0%, demonstrating the benefit of adapting visual conditioning throughout action generation.

papers.title_en: WinDEX: Metric 3D Hand Motion Reconstruction in the Wild for Dexterous Teleoperation and Policy Learning
papers.authors: Hongyu Ma, Hairong Qu, Shiqi Zhao, Yongsong Yang, Kai Shi, Jiahao Ai, Xin You, Peng Yin
papers.evidence: 从野外双目视频重建米制三维手部动作，用于灵巧遥操作和策略学习
papers.tldr: 训练机器人灵巧操作需要大量真实人类动作数据，但野外采集难以同时实现米制精度、场景泛化和高速推理。WinDEX结合几何—时序优化、视觉惯性定位与鱼眼原生网络，从双目视频重建手部动作，并用模型辅助标注形成迭代数据流程。其数据集包含千小时训练标注；离线重建达43.61帧/秒，因果流式推理达171帧/秒，世界坐标关节误差为37.29毫米。基于重建动作训练的策略成功率优于既有方法，并实现实时臂手遥操作，为低成本规模化数据采集和机器人学习提供了实用方案。
papers.abstract_en: Human manipulation data are widely used to train robots for human-like dexterity. However, low-cost, large-scale collection in the wild remains challenging. Existing methods remain limited in geometrically grounded metric-scale reconstruction, real-world generalization and inference speed. We present WinDEX, integrating (1) geometric-temporal optimization for metric 3D hand annotation from in-the-wild egocentric stereo videos, combined with visual-inertial SLAM for world-frame reconstruction; (2) WinDEX-Net, an end-to-end, fisheye-native network combining calibrated stereo, local detail and temporal context, with a data-model flywheel of model-assisted annotation and retraining; (3) distilled models for offline reconstruction and causal streaming, supporting reinforcement learning and teleoperation; and (4) low-cost CyberCap stereo-inertial capture, forming the WinDEX-Hand dataset with 1,000 hours of training annotations and held-out human-annotated in-the-wild 2D and independent optical motion-capture evaluation sets. Offline reconstruction runs at 43.61 FPS and causal streaming at 171 FPS. On held-out data, offline reconstruction achieves state-of-the-art accuracy: 14.5 pixels in-the-wild reprojection error and, with visual-inertial odometry, 37.29 mm world-frame joint error. We achieve 7.6 and 3.6 times the task success rates of reinforcement learning policies trained with WiLoR and HaWoR motion references, respectively, and demonstrate real-time arm-hand teleoperation. Project website: https://fruitrabbit.github.io/WinDEX/.

papers.title_en: Cooperative Mobile Manipulation using Learned Dynamical Systems
papers.authors: Saray Bakker, Wendelin Böhmer, Javier Alonso-Mora
papers.evidence: 机器人协同移动操作与碰撞规避
papers.tldr: 移动操作机器人协作执行任务时，既要协调运动、避免全身碰撞，也要保留示范中的关键行为；单机器人学得的动作难以直接安全组合。CALDS先筛选相互兼容的已学策略，再通过时间适配协调执行，同时维持原行为的空间结构与收敛性。研究在辅助穿衣、餐厅清理与服务、开抽屉并放置物体三类场景中进行评估。定量结果显示，该方法提升任务成功率，支持安全协同并行执行，并保持对示范行为的保真度，为复用单机器人技能提供了框架。
papers.abstract_en: Cooperative mobile manipulation requires robots to coordinate their motions while ensuring whole-body collision avoidance and preserving task-relevant behaviors. We propose CALDS (Cooperative Adaptation of Learned Dynamical Systems), a framework that enables mobile manipulators to adapt learned single-agent behaviors for coordinated execution. Building on individual dynamical systems (DSs) learned from demonstrations, CALDS enables cooperative adaptation through two key components: Cooperative Policy Selection, which identifies compatible combinations of learned policies, and Temporal Adaptation, which ensures collision-free cooperation while preserving the spatial structure and convergence properties of the original behaviors. We evaluate CALDS across three diverse scenarios: assistive dressing, restaurant cleaning and serving, and drawer opening and object placement. Quantitative results demonstrate its effectiveness in improving task success and enabling safe, coordinated simultaneous execution while maintaining fidelity to demonstrated behaviors.

papers.title_en: LynnReal-Hand: Unlocking World Interaction with Hand Control
papers.authors: Shaohao Rui, Chaoyang Zhang, Xiaofeng Mao, Weijie Ma
papers.evidence: 通过手部控制实现对环境物体的直接交互
papers.tldr: 交互式视频世界模型通常通过文本或镜头控制，难以实现对物体的精细操作；手势控制虽自然，却要求模型准确呈现复杂的手物动态，并满足实时生成需求。LynnReal-Hand以10万段真实与合成交互视频为基础，采用手部感知监督、因果流映射、区域感知分数蒸馏和轻量视频解码器。HandBench上完整模型取得181.67的FVD与93.02的MANO Dice，三步生成的Dice仍达92.49。单张H200上，540p流式生成达到每秒18.03帧、延迟741毫秒；该工作推动了精细、低延迟的手控视频世界模型研究。
papers.abstract_en: Interactive video world models enable exploration through text and camera controls, yet direct object interaction requires finer control. Hands provide a natural interface, but translating continuous hand movements into coherent visual responses remains challenging because of complex hand-object dynamics and demanding real-time computation. To address these challenges, we introduce LynnReal-Hand, a hand-controlled video world model that unifies precise interaction modeling with efficient streaming generation. We curate 100K interaction clips spanning diverse real and synthetic environments and develop hand-aware supervision to improve fine-grained hand motions and object interactions. Building on this foundation, we learn a causal flow map for few-step generation and introduce region-aware score distillation that combines complementary video and image priors to refine interaction dynamics and visual appearance. To further reduce inference latency, we propose Ultra-Fast-VAE, a compact video decoder that preserves high reconstruction fidelity with substantially lower computational cost. Extensive evaluations on HandBench demonstrate superior hand-following accuracy and visual quality compared with existing approaches. Our full-sequence model achieves an FVD of 181.67 and a MANO Dice score of 93.02, while the three-step causal model maintains a MANO Dice score of 92.49. For real-time interaction, 540p streaming on a single H200 reaches 18.03 FPS with 741ms latency and an optimized peak GPU memory footprint of only 34.89GB. We will release the datasets, model weights, and the full training and inference code to support research on hand-controlled video world models.

papers.title_en: Lost in the Hallway: Benchmarking Persistent Spatial Memory Across Revisits
papers.authors: Henry Zheng, Weibo Gong, Yang Yue, Rui Huang, Yang Zhang, Gao Huang
papers.evidence: 评测具身智能体在重复访问场景中的空间记忆与环境理解
papers.tldr: 具身智能体反复进入环境时，必须跨视角认出同一房间、区分相似房间，并追踪物品变化；现有评测对隔次访问中的物理地点身份考察不足。论文提出 ReSpaceBench，以受控行走轨迹构建 3,244 道问题，覆盖 590 个合成与真实家庭场景、9 项任务，并另提供训练集 RS-30K。32 个模型中最佳零样本准确率仅 50.5%，远低于人类的 90.1%；微调后模型达到 60.4%。结果表明，跨访问房间关联和证据遗漏仍是核心难题，单靠迭代搜证不足以建立可靠空间记忆。
papers.abstract_en: Persistent spatial understanding is essential for embodied agents to operate reliably in environments they repeatedly encounter. It requires recognizing revisited places despite viewpoint changes, distinguishing them from similar-looking rooms, and updating memories as environments change. Yet existing evaluations often leave physical place identity across separated visits implicit. We introduce ReSpaceBench, a benchmark comprising 3,244 questions across 590 synthetic and real-home scenes, organized into 9 tasks spanning room association, persistent state tracking, and downstream reasoning. Controlled walkthroughs define visits by physical room entry and deliberately include same-type room distractors and cross-session object changes. Our evaluation of 32 models and 3 agentic video-understanding frameworks reveals substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated zero-shot model achieves 50.5% overall accuracy and 52.2% on a 450-question subset, compared with 90.1% for human annotators. The evaluated agentic frameworks offer no overall improvement over direct inference with the same base model. Analysis of agent execution traces reveals evidence omissions and incorrect cross-visit room associations as major failure modes, suggesting that iterative evidence seeking alone does not ensure consistent spatial memory. Further analyses expose a gap between recognizing familiar rooms and identifying the correct visited room, while annotation-guided sampling highlights the importance of preserving intervening visits and transitions. We also provide RS-30K, a separate training dataset from synthetic sources with no template, scene, route, or video overlap with the benchmark. Fine-tuning Qwen3-VL-8B raises overall accuracy from 35.5% to 60.4%, with the largest gains in association and improvements extending to real-life scenes.

papers.title_en: ScaleVLA: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models to 552 Billion Parameters
papers.authors: Ruixi Yu, Dairu Liu, Xuchuan Chen, Zekun Qi, Zekai Li, Zhuo Cao, Luyang Niu, Yingsheng Zhang, Sikai Liang, Ke Fan, He Wang, Li Yi
papers.evidence: 比较视觉语言动作模型规模及其机器人学习能力
papers.tldr: 机器人基础模型仍多采用较小视觉语言骨干，难以充分利用大规模预训练知识，提升样本效率、泛化与精细操作能力仍是关键问题。ScaleVLA将5520亿参数DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash连接可训练动作扩散Transformer，并在统一训练设置下比较20亿至5520亿参数视觉语言模型。仅用10条示范即达87.8%，超过小模型用50条的85.6%；LIBERO-PRO成功率达45.1%，充电器插入实测由4/10升至9/10，动作块中位延迟216毫秒。结果表明前沿视觉语言模型可作为高效且具泛化性的机器人策略表征基础，而非仅用于推理。
papers.abstract_en: Frontier Vision-Language Models (VLMs) such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in robot control, suggesting that broad pretraining provides knowledge valuable for physical action. Yet most Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies still rely on much smaller VLM backbones, leaving this potential largely untapped. We ask whether frontier-scale representations can provide a stronger foundation for robot learning. We introduce ScaleVLA, which connects a 552B DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash backbone to a trainable action DiT, and systematically compare VLMs from 2B to 552B under a shared training setup. We evaluate three fundamental capabilities of robot foundation models. In sample efficiency, just 10 demonstrations outperform a 2B backbone trained with 50 (87.8% vs. 85.6%). In generalization, LIBERO-PRO success reaches 45.1%, compared with at most 31.3% for smaller backbones. In precise manipulation, real-world charger insertion improves from 4/10 to 9/10 successes, with gains concentrated in contact-sensitive alignment. Despite its scale, ScaleVLA achieves 216 ms median latency per action chunk. Our findings suggest that frontier VLMs can serve not only as reasoning agents, but also as powerful representational foundations for efficient and generalizable robot policies.

papers.title_en: GridDriver: On-Board BEV-Based Language Planning and Reasoning
papers.authors: Katharina Winter, William Engel, Zain A. Alishammat, Fabian B. Flohr
papers.evidence: 结合鸟瞰环境感知、轨迹预测和驾驶导航
papers.tldr: 车载语言交互驾驶要求系统理解BEV场景并持续规划，同时兼顾自回归语言生成带来的算力与时延压力。GridDriver以轻量时空BEV感知和空间结构化令牌向共享大语言模型提供场景信息，并用逐帧调度交错轨迹预测与异步语言生成。系统在NAVSIM取得87.9% PDMS、nuScenes-QA取得57.6%准确率，独立规划延迟为32.7毫秒，车载ROS 2流水线达每秒9.4次规划。结果表明该方案可兼顾规划、问答与解释，并经公开基准和实车开环运行验证，同时揭示其优势与局限。
papers.abstract_en: Bird's-Eye-View (BEV)-conditioned large language models (LLMs) enable language-interactive driving, but onboard deployment requires efficient perception and continuous planning alongside autoregressive language generation. We present GridDriver, an efficient BEV-conditioned LLM framework combining trajectory prediction, structured driving indicators, natural-language navigation, driving explanations, and scene question answering. Lightweight spatio-temporal BEV perception and spatially structured tokens provide scene context to a shared LLM, while frame-wise scheduling interleaves trajectory prediction with asynchronous language generation. GridDriver achieves competitive performance on public benchmarks, reaching 87.9% PDMS on NAVSIM and 57.6% accuracy on nuScenes-QA with a shared planning and QA checkpoint. Spatial representation analyses demonstrate improved geometric information retention and trajectory prediction compared with Q-Former compression. The system achieves 32.7 ms standalone planning latency and 9.4 plans/s in an onboard ROS 2 pipeline. We further evaluate planning on our own data recordings and demonstrate open-loop onboard operation on a research vehicle. Across public benchmarks and real-world evaluations, we identify strengths and limitations of the BEV-based approach.

papers.title_en: HubEgo-100K: In-the-Wild Egocentric Video of Skilled Work for Robot Learning
papers.authors: Javad Amirian, Armin Kiani, Loïc Schaeffer, Tim Sprecher, Mohamed Taha, Karthik Yadati
papers.evidence: 为机器人学习提供大规模、真实世界的第一视角技能工作视频
papers.tldr: 机器人模仿学习难以泛化到训练中未见的环境与物体，研究指出增加环境和物体多样性比单纯增加同一环境的演示更有帮助，但大规模采集机器人数据成本高，现有第一人称视频也缺少真实职场技能。HubEgo-100K因此汇集贡献者在日常工作场景中自行拍摄的非脚本头戴视频，并同步记录惯性数据，配以机器生成的动作和语言标注。首版包含10,124小时视频、72,754个片段，覆盖15,548个环境，且83%时长来自工作场所。该数据集为研究技能理解和机器人跨环境学习提供多样化资源，后续版本将扩展至10万小时并加入基准测试。
papers.abstract_en: Robot policies trained by imitation generalize poorly outside the environments and objects seen in training. Published data-scaling studies find that generalization grows with the diversity of training environments and objects rather than with more demonstrations per environment. Robot data is costly to collect across many environments, whereas egocentric human video can be recorded in the wild at scale; existing egocentric video, however, mostly shows daily-life activity and contains little skilled work in real workplaces. We present HubEgo-100K, a dataset built for diversity. This version of the paper covers the first release, v1.0: 10,124 hours of 1080p egocentric video with synchronized 100 Hz inertial (IMU) data from one head-mounted phone camera. In v1.0, 12,227 contributors record their own unscripted work in 15,548 environments (each one contributor's own setting of one type, such as their kitchen or workshop) across 11 setting types, 30 work categories, 56 task types and 35 action families, with 83% of hours in workplace settings. The release comprises 72,754 episodes with machine-generated action and language annotations, in LeRobot and MCAP formats under CC BY 4.0. We measure diversity along each axis, show that inside v1.0, with episodes in random order, new contributors and words keep appearing, and relate the measurements to published evidence on six data properties tied to policy performance, including hand visibility and inertial sensing. We also document collection, curation, privacy measures and data format, and provide a datasheet. Later versions of this paper will add benchmarks and cover further releases toward 100,000 hours.

papers.title_en: SE(3)-LIVOM: Adaptive Multi-LiDAR-Inertial-Visual Odometry and Mapping
papers.authors: Gunhee Shin, Seungjae Lee, Daebeom Kim, Seoyeon Jang, Hyun Myung
papers.evidence: 为腿式机器人提供实时多传感器定位与建图
papers.tldr: 针对腿式机器人在坍塌建筑、施工现场和雪地等复杂环境中的定位建图需求，SE(3)-LIVOM面向GrandTour数据集构建多传感器实时里程计系统。其前端融合双雷达、相机与IMU，并自适应调整降采样，使单次扫描耗时维持在约35毫秒；后端通过子图平面束调整和增量位姿图校正漂移。采用适用于所有场景的单一配置，系统在六个测试场景上取得1.40厘米平均绝对轨迹误差。该方法兼顾实时性与精度，为复杂环境下的腿式机器人自主定位和建图提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents SE(3)-LIVOM, the overall winner of the COMFORT Challenge at IROS 2026. The challenge asks for the trajectory of a legged robot in the GrandTour dataset, whose scenes include collapsed buildings, construction sites and snowfields. SE(3)-LIVOM runs in real time on two LiDARs, one camera and an IMU. Its frontend extends SE(3)-LIO to multiple LiDARs and a camera. Adaptive downsampling keeps the time per scan near 35 ms within and across scenes. An online backend corrects drift with a plane bundle adjustment over submaps and an incremental pose graph. With a single configuration for all scenes, the system reaches an average ATE of 1.40 cm on the six test scenes. The code is available at https://github.com/url-kaist/se3-livom-comfort.

papers.title_en: RoboTeam: Benchmarking Vision-Based Multi-Agent Control of Many Robot Arms in Real Time
papers.authors: Changxuan Fan, Zhongwei Xie, Boyi Zhang, Shaoli Hu, Chang Xu, Xiyu Ren, Yufei Li, Qiao Xiao, Huihao Jing, Kawai Chung, Wenbin Hu, Hongyu Luo, Lingyun Xie, Yisen Gao, Chunyang Li, Haoyu Huang, Wuganjing Song, Yuxuan Liu, Chiu Yeung Tang, Fangneng Zhan, Xi Yang
papers.evidence: 在相机图像输入下评测多机器人手臂实时控制，直接关联具身智能系统能力与评估。
papers.tldr: 现有多模态机器人基准多只测试一两条机械臂和短时任务，常暂停环境或提供物体真值位置，难以反映真实协作控制。RoboTeam构建纯视觉、实时运行的模拟基准，让4至16条机械臂协作完成36项长时任务。自适应调度系统中，gpt-6.1-sol与opus-5.5分别完成28和27项，但单任务耗时、令牌与重试成本高。基准还比较四类调度架构，揭示速度、成本和可靠性难以兼得，为评估多臂协作智能体提供新压力测试。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal agents can now control robot arms by calling tools and writing code. Existing benchmarks fall short in three ways: most test one or two arms on short tasks, many pause the world while the agent thinks, and many give it ground-truth object positions. We present RoboTeam, a simulated benchmark where agents control 4 to 16 robot arms in real time from camera images alone. Its 36 tasks are long jobs that the arms must do together, such as passing timbers or building a picture from hundreds of cubes. We start from the most flexible agent system, the adaptive system, where one agent decides when to fork delegates. With it, gpt-6.1-sol and opus-5.5 complete 28 and 27 tasks, and four other models at most 3. But at a high price: a typical task takes gpt-6.1-sol 3.5 hours and 218 million input tokens, and a third of its steps fail at least once and must be retried. We then compare it with three fixed systems: single-agent, hierarchical, and decentralized. All four complete a similar number of tasks but differ in time and tokens. The hierarchical and decentralized systems are faster but use up to 1.9 times the tokens, and the single agent uses fewer tokens but takes 1.6 times as long, so the adaptive system lies between them. Even so, no model or system is yet fast, cheap, and reliable at once. RoboTeam measures these limits where earlier benchmarks cannot: long multi-arm jobs, camera images only, and a world that never pauses.

papers.title_en: TRIDENT: Efficient Triple-Task Learning of Dehazing, Depth, and Uncertainty Estimation for Underwater 3-D Robot Visual Perception
papers.authors: Geonmo Yang, Younggun Cho
papers.evidence: 为水下机器人提供深度估计与三维视觉感知
papers.tldr: 水下光传播易造成图像纹理模糊、颜色对比度不足，削弱机器人稳定操作所需的视觉感知。为同时处理增强、距离和可靠性信息，论文提出轻量模型TRIDENT，以共享骨干提取特征，并通过三个并行解码器联合学习图像增强、深度估计和不确定性。多个标准数据集实验显示，该方法在增强与深度估计上优于已有方法，内存占用和推理时间也更具优势。联合学习还提升了特征匹配鲁棒性，并支持从二维视觉延伸至三维感知。
papers.abstract_en: Underwater visual systems often suffer from blurry textures and low color contrast due to the inevitable light propagation. These issues can significantly degrade the perception of stable robotic operations. In this paper, we introduce a novel learning-based sensing system that tackles the multidimensional vision tasks in underwater; concretely, we deal with image enhancement, depth estimation, and uncertainty for 3-D visual systems. Also, we propose a TRIDENT model in a fast and lightweight manner; TRIDENT consists of three parallelized decoders and one backbone structure for efficient feature sharing. In addition, it is designed to be trained to express complex parameterization. In experimental evaluation on several standard datasets, we demonstrate that TRIDENT significantly outperforms other existing methods on image enhancement and depth estimation. Despite performing three tasks, our model has better efficiency than the others for both memory size and inference time. Finally, our joint learning approach demonstrates robustness in feature matching and seamlessly extends from 2-D to 3-D vision tasks. Supplements are available at https://sites.google.com/view/underwater-trident/home

papers.title_en: From Temperature-Limited to Battery-Limited Legged Locomotion
papers.authors: Raphaël Ségas, Balázs Opra, Léo Ghafari, Thomas Stewart
papers.evidence: 用内部热动力学模型支持四足机器人的持续运动策略
papers.tldr: 腿式机器人持续行走常因少数关节电机过热而提前停机，此时电池尚未耗尽；热惯性又远超强化学习的信用分配时域，使直接依据温度反馈优化困难。本文拟合热网络，并设计奖励引导策略降低、分散电机热负荷，训练时无需观测温度。Go2实测中，负载行走由19分钟提升至174分钟并耗尽电池；工厂路线单次充电圈数由25增至47。结果将持续行走的瓶颈从温度转为电池，提升了长时 locomotion 的可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: On legged robots, sustained locomotion often ends in thermal shutdown rather than battery depletion: the heat of walking concentrates in a few joint motors, which overheat long before the battery is empty. We train thermally aware locomotion policies by reinforcement learning without ever observing temperature, and demonstrate this on a Unitree Go2 quadruped. We first identify a coupled 13-node lumped RC thermal network, fitted on two runs of a single robot and calibrated against the measured electrical power, that predicts all twelve motor temperatures with a mean RMSE below 1 $^\circ$C across different robot instances, gaits, payloads, and speeds. Under a sustained gait, the temperatures the motors will settle at follow directly from the gait-averaged squared torques and joint speeds. Our core contribution is a reward that drives down the hottest predicted asymptotes: thermal time constants exceed the credit-assignment horizon of reinforcement learning by orders of magnitude, but predicted asymptotes respond to torque and joint speed within a single gait cycle, so the policy learns to lower and spread heat with no temperature input. On the robot, the policy turns sustained locomotion from temperature-limited to battery-limited: with a 5 kg payload at 1 m/s, a learned baseline reaches thermal shutdown after 19 minutes (1.1 km), whereas our policy runs the battery down after 174 minutes (10.0 km) with its hottest motor 14 $^\circ$C below the shutdown threshold in a 26 $^\circ$C room; on an unloaded factory circuit with stairs and ramps, the baseline overheats after 25 laps (6.2 km), while our policy completes 47 (11.2 km) on one battery with 22 $^\circ$C of margin.

papers.title_en: ALERT: Extending Humanoid Motion Trackers with a General and Lightweight Human Avoidance Pipeline
papers.authors: Zhaoyang Li, Chiyu Zhang, Chengxin Xu, Peng Yang, Zhonghao Guo, Wanting Li, Ziyu Chen
papers.evidence: 为人形机器人运动跟踪策略加入人类感知和主动避让
papers.tldr: 全身动作跟踪已支持人形机器人舞蹈、运动和遥操作，但现有策略难以感知附近人类并主动避让；动作替换或局部约束修正还可能损害参考动作完整性与跟踪连续性。ALERT提出通用轻量流程，将人类感知和主动避让融入预训练跟踪策略，协调避让需求与参考动作跟踪。仿真及真实实验表明，多种跟踪骨干均能局部避人、无碰撞执行，保持全身协调并快速恢复跟踪。该方法在保留预训练策略原有能力及未见动作跟踪能力的同时，为共享人机环境提供了易扩展的避让方案。
papers.abstract_en: Whole-body motion tracking has enabled humanoid dancing, athletic motions, and teleoperation, providing a foundation for capability demonstrations and manipulation data collection. However, existing tracking policies lack awareness of nearby humans and proactive avoidance capabilities, while motion substitution and local constraint-based corrections may compromise reference motion integrity and tracking continuity. We propose ALERT, a general lightweight pipeline for extending motion tracking to shared human-robot environments. Through lightweight adaptation, it integrates human perception and proactive avoidance into pretrained tracking policies, balancing avoidance demands with reference motion tracking while preserving existing motion capabilities. Simulation and real-world experiments across tracking backbones demonstrate reliable collision-free execution through localized human avoidance, preserving whole-body coordination and enabling rapid recovery of reference tracking, while retaining the ability of pretrained policies to track unseen motions.
